# Matias Ezequiel Marani

> Full Stack Developer and Engineering Manager based in Madrid, Spain. I have spent more than seven years building web applications and more than five years leading development teams. My main tools are JavaScript, Vue, Node.js and Go. I am currently building an AI agent team for day-to-day software delivery with human developers.

Information Systems Engineer from the National Technical University in Rosario, Argentina. My open-source projects include img2gcode, a Node.js and Jimp package for converting images to G-code; codereview.nvim, a Neovim plugin for reviewing Git diffs; El Coso 3000, a browser-only image and video placeholder generator; and Marvis, a desktop app for Git repositories and worktrees. I am currently available for opportunities.

## Profile

- [Home (English)](https://maranimatias.github.io/): summary, skills, open-source projects and contact links.

## Skills

- Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue 2, Vue 3, HTML, CSS, Pinia, Vuex, Vite and Vitest.
- Backend: Go, Node.js, Python, MongoDB, MySQL and MariaDB.
- Architecture: Hexagonal Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and microservices.
- Mobile: Ionic, Capacitor and Framework7.
- Testing: Jest and Vitest.
- DevOps: GitLab CI/CD, Bash scripting and Docker.
- AI-assisted engineering: building and coordinating AI agents for day-to-day work with human developers.
- Tools: Git, Vim and Neovim.

## Experience

- EXTE (formerly SunMedia), Project Manager & Technical Lead, July 2021 to present. I lead a team of five developers building SunStudio, a Figma-like web ad creation platform. I chose the project structure and stack, introduced DDD and Hexagonal Architecture, and set up GitLab CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment time from 40 minutes to 3. I trained more than 15 team members on Vite and GitLab CI. Stack: Vue 3, Pinia, Vite, Vitest, Python and GitLab CI/CD.
- SunMedia, Senior Frontend Developer, December 2020 to July 2021. I built a data-management application for advertising campaigns and the company's shared UI component library, used across eight or more internal projects. I improved app speed by 30%. Stack: Vue.js, Vuex, Webpack and Jest.
- Rapicopia, Full Stack Developer, November 2018 to August 2021, alongside my role at Tribal Consulting. I built the frontend for a customer management system and RapicopiaApp, a local Go server for branch printing and note management. I reduced customer processing time by 25%. Stack: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Webpack and Go.
- Tribal Consulting, Full Stack Developer, July 2018 to October 2020, alongside Rapicopia. I delivered client projects for web and mobile products, including cross-platform apps with Ionic. Stack: Vue.js, Ionic, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, Nuxt.js and Webpack.
- Freelance, Event Management Platform, November 2017 to February 2018. I built an event management system with real-time updates. Stack: Ionic, Cordova, Angular.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB.

## Key projects

- Hornera (personal project): rental management system for a temporary rental business. It covers availability, cleaning, maintenance, billing, and Booking.com and Airbnb integrations. It automated 90% of manual processes and cut operating costs by 50%. Stack: Go backend, MariaDB, Vue 3 frontend and Framework7 mobile app.
- [img2gcode](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/img2gcode): converts JPG, PNG and GIF images into G-code for CNC machines and laser engravers. It uses a pathfinding algorithm to trace a short route between pixels. TypeScript and Node.js. 42 stars.
- [codereview.nvim](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/codereview.nvim): Neovim plugin for reviewing Git diffs with inline notes, unified or side-by-side views, file exploration, Markdown and table exports, Telescope support and Git difftool integration. Lua and Neovim. 10 stars.
- [El Coso 3000](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/el-coso-3000): browser-only image and video placeholder generator, distributed as a single HTML file. Creates assets locally in PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, GIF, AVI, ZIP, MP4, WebM, MOV and MKV formats, with nine color pairs meeting WCAG AA contrast. [Demo](https://el-coso-3000.maranimatias.workers.dev/).
- [Marvis](https://github.com/MaraniMatias/Marvis): desktop app for Git repositories and worktrees, keeping files, diffs, terminals and line-linked review notes organized per checkout. Supports CLI coding agents, optional OpenCode integration, macOS and Linux; MIT licensed.
